minimum_evidence_threshold: dated official packet or response containing agenda/slides/minutes/transcript/recording/public statement/preliminary findings with custodian and scope
insufficient_evidence_examples: pre-meeting notice; route page; local news article; unhashable notes; oral recollection
red_flags: missing custodian; missing date; summary says satisfactory with no issues but no evaluator basis; public Q&A omitted

minimum_evidence_threshold: exercise-specific evidence of channels tested, message templates, delivery/failure logs or evaluator observations, exceptions, corrective actions, retest/closure, and AFN/language access handling
insufficient_evidence_examples: public brochure; siren decommission notice; IPAWS mentioned in agenda; generic plan
red_flags: no failure log; no delivery/time evidence; no AFN/language evidence; corrective actions lack closure/retest

minimum_evidence_threshold: records showing root cause, restoration date/time, alternate generator repair/retest, compensatory measure termination, CAP owner, retest evidence, and recurrence controls
insufficient_evidence_examples: NRC event notification alone; statement that power expected soon; compensatory measures only
red_flags: unknown generator failure cause remains open; no retest; no CAP closeout; no link to exercise readiness

risk_area: access and functional needs / language access
minimum_evidence_threshold: exercise-specific evidence for AFN/language/hearing/visual access warning, transport, shelter/reception, KI/public instruction, privacy-protected registry handling, and corrective actions
insufficient_evidence_examples: annual mailer; special-assistance card existence; generic plan; public webpage
red_flags: no exercise observation; identifiable special-needs records exposed; no language channels; no transportation/shelter evidence

risk_area: corrective action / improvement plan / retest closure
minimum_evidence_threshold: AAR/IP or CAP record with issue, owner, target date, completion evidence, retest method/date, and closure authority
insufficient_evidence_examples: verbal claim; no-issue summary without evaluator basis; old closure not tied to 2026 exercise
red_flags: open items without dates; closure without retest; duplicate issue aliases; records withheld without segregable summary

risk_area: response packet chain of custody and public release
minimum_evidence_threshold: sidecar metadata, receipt/portal proof, file hash, custodian, received_at, redaction/DLP status, artifact class, proofcut mapping, and fixture/no-fixture flag
insufficient_evidence_examples: loose attachment; copied text without source; unlogged screenshot; fixture treated as evidence
red_flags: hash mismatch; missing custodian; fixture_only=yes; sensitive personal/security data in public lane
